about: The gk core zips the gk hook store workflow may run, by gk version and platform: the release URL it is fetched from (no redirect) and its sha256. A run with no pin here, or with a zip whose sum differs, stops before gk is unpacked. A new version is fetched with the workflow's record: true, which prints the URL and sum and never runs gk; check it, then add it here.
